{{Otheruses|Hanna}}
[[File:MonMothma2.jpg|thumb|250px|Mon Mothma wearing a Hanna pendant.]]
A '''Hanna pendant''' was a piece of jewelry worn by the [[Gender/Legends|women]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The pendant included three ropes, each made of metal rings, which connected to the shoulder. A decorated clasp connected the shoulder of the clothing to the metal ring ropes. On the shortest rope, against the neck or chest, was a metal pendant which was stylized. [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] was known to wear one regularly.<ref name="Pendant">{{CSWECite|II|14|Hanna Pendant}}</ref>
